title: Aging in Spherical Spin Glass Dynamics
abstract: Lean formalization of the spherical Gaussian spin-glass dynamics and its positive-semidefinite Cugliandolo--Kurchan limit, including the physical variational response, entropy and Fisher estimates, stationary translated clusters, general-spin selection and aging bounds, and stationary relaxation. Theorem 11.4 covers every integer p >= 3 and beta > 0. The cubic product inequality includes beta = beta_d; strictly positive Fisher-cost conclusions require beta > beta_d. The root Challenge retains the original complete-conclusions theorem with the five principal theorem groups and all-spin forward theorem, sharing CK, stationary-profile, dimension-subsequence, density and Fisher-majorant witnesses. The same file separately retains the original Proposition 5.7 statement for every CK solution, every late sequence and every raw translated cluster.
